weather_report:
As the evening unfolds over Boston, a thick quilt of cloud blankets the city, dimming the light but not entirely extinguishing it. The temperature hovers gently around fifty-two degrees, where the cool air carries whispers of autumn, urging you to wear layers. A soft southwesterly breeze dances around, nearly imperceptible at first, yet its presence hints at a warmer day to come. 

Tomorrow promises a vivid return of sunshine, with temperatures rising to a pleasant seventy-six. The day will be a gradual transformation, as the warmth seeps in and those fluffy clouds retreat, revealing a brilliant expanse of azure. Such a day invites a variety of pursuits; perhaps an afternoon stroll along the Charles, where leaves crunch underfoot, or finding a favorite café to enjoy the blend of warmth and light filtering through the windows. Dressing in comfortable layers—light enough for the day but cozy enough for the evening chill—will serve you well as the sun dips. In this moment, the city lies in quiet anticipation, preparing to step into the embrace of autumn’s splendor.
